holidays.name: Just Because Day
holidays.description: A holiday that exists for no reason at all. Celebrate by doing something nice, fun, or silly simply because you feel like it, with no occasion required.
holidays.origin: Believed to have been created in the early 2000s as an unofficial observance and spread through greeting card culture and online holiday calendars. Its creator is unclear, which suits a day without a reason.
holidays.funFact: Because there is no required reason to celebrate, it is one of the few holidays that no one can claim you are celebrating wrong.

holidays.name: Pots de Creme Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate pots de creme, the silky French custard dessert served in tiny pots or cups. Chocolate is the most popular flavor, but vanilla, coffee, and caramel versions exist too.
holidays.origin: The dessert comes from France, where the name means 'pots of cream.' The day is a food observance listed on national food holiday calendars.
holidays.funFact: Pots de creme are traditionally baked in special lidded porcelain cups called pots de creme, which look like tiny teapots.

holidays.name: Cow Milked While Flying in an Airplane Day
holidays.description: A day honoring one of the oddest stunts in aviation history, when a cow was milked in mid-air. Participants are advised to keep their celebrations at ground level.
holidays.origin: It marks the 1930 flight of a cow named Elm Farm Ollie, who became the first cow to fly in an airplane, and the first to be milked in flight. The event took place in 1930 at the International Air Exposition in St. Louis, Missouri, and some sources list the day as August 27.
holidays.funFact: The milk was sealed into paper cartons and parachuted down to spectators on the ground, and Ollie reportedly produced 24 quarts.

holidays.name: National Banana Lovers Day
holidays.description: A day for fans of the world's most popular fruit to eat banana splits, banana bread, smoothies, and plain old bananas. Peel-slipping jokes are encouraged.
holidays.origin: Banana Lovers Day is a food observance that has been promoted since the 2000s by food holiday calendars and banana enthusiasts, as a salute to the humble yellow fruit.
holidays.funFact: Bananas are technically berries, while strawberries are not.

holidays.name: Great Lakes Day Observance of Lunar Gravity... Moon Pie Appreciation
holidays.description: Fans of the marshmallow-and-graham sandwich cookie dunked in chocolate celebrate the Moon Pie on this day with taste tests and silly picnics.
holidays.origin: Moon Pies were first made in 1917 in Chattanooga, Tennessee, by the Chattanooga Bakery. A coal miner reportedly asked for a snack as big as the moon, and the bakers obliged.
holidays.funFact: In Bell Buckle, Tennessee, an annual festival features a giant Moon Pie and an RC Cola, a pairing known as the 'working man's lunch.'
